arithmetic: For every K-support coordinate of every frozen square-terminal F state, quotient the support group modulo R by the subgroup generated by all other support primes. The cyclic quotient target class gives the exact minimum absolute exponent and coordinatewise overflow floor over the full target fiber.
scope_note: The coordinate floor is selection-invariant over the complete target fiber, but it is only a coordinatewise necessity. It does not prove a carrier charge, a compatible carrier flow, an overflow-to-carrier injection, or a universal Type I/II escape theorem.  The extended box independently maximizes each coordinate over the two source blocks and is therefore an optimistic rectangular proxy.
